content_sections.heading: UCSL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: Register for Job Alerts Udupi Cochin Shipyard Limited has announced ITI Trade Apprentice vacancies under Apprentices Act 1961. The notification includes Electrician and Plumber trades with a total of 9 seats. The organization has also announced Graduate/Technician (Diploma) Apprentice training seats for Mechanical Engineering and Electrical Engineering disciplines with a total of 3 seats. ITI Trade Apprentices under Apprentices Act 1961 Graduate/Technician (Diploma) Apprentices under Apprentices (Amendment) Act 1973

content_sections.heading: UCSL Apprentice Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 12 apprentice training seats are available under UCSL Apprentice Recruitment 2026.

content_sections.heading: UCSL Apprentice Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for UCSL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the educational qualification, age and other eligibility requirements mentioned in the official notification.

rows.qualification: Pass in X Standard and Pass in ITI in the concerned trade with National Trade Certificate (NTC) in the designated trades
Diploma in Engineering/Technology in relevant discipline from State Council/Board of Technical Education, University or recognized institution

content_sections.heading: UCSL Apprentice Training Duration
content_sections.text: The duration of apprenticeship training under UCSL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 will be for a period of one year. ITI Trade Apprentices will undergo training under the Apprentices Act 1961, while Diploma Apprentices will undergo training under the Apprentices (Amendment) Act 1973.

content_sections.heading: UCSL Apprentice Previous Training Eligibility
content_sections.text: Candidates who have already undergone apprenticeship training in any organization under the respective Apprentices Act are not eligible to apply.

content_sections.heading: UCSL Apprentice Application Fee
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for UCSL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 do not need to pay any application fee.

content_sections.heading: UCSL Apprentice Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process for UCSL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 includes shortlisting, certificate verification and selection based on merit. Candidates will be shortlisted based on marks obtained in the prescribed qualification. Shortlisted candidates will be called for certificate verification. Candidates completing verification successfully will be considered for selection against available seats based on merit, reservation and medical fitness.

content_sections.heading: UCSL Apprentice Apply Online Details
content_sections.text: The application process differs based on the apprentice category. Download and fill the application form provided in the notification. Paste a recent passport size photograph on the application form. Sign the application form. Send the scanned copy of the signed application form along with supporting documents through email. Send the application to: [email protected] After submission, candidates will receive a unique registration number through email.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UCSL Diploma Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the NATS portal. Complete registration/login process. Search for “UDUPI COCHIN SHIPYARD LIMITED” under advertised vacancies. Click on Apply option. Complete the application process and verify application status.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for UCSL Apprentice Application
content_sections.text: Application form with photograph and signature (for ITI Apprentice) Proof of age certificate Educational qualification certificates ITI Certificate / Diploma Certificate Mark sheets Caste certificate, if applicable Disability certificate, if applicable

faq.question: Q1. What is UCSL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: UCSL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive by Udupi Cochin Shipyard Limited for engaging ITI and Diploma apprentices for one year apprenticeship training.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in UCSL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 12 apprentice training seats are available, including 9 ITI Apprentice seats and 3 Diploma Apprentice seats.

faq.question: Q3. What are the posts available in UCSL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available trades include Electrician, Plumber, Mechanical Engineering and Electrical Engineering apprentices.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for UCSL ITI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed X Standard and ITI in the concerned trade with National Trade Certificate (NTC).

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for UCSL Diploma Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Diploma in Engineering/Technology in the relevant discipline from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for UCSL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be minimum 18 years of age as on 14 October 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the stipend in UCSL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ITI Apprentices will receive ₹12,600 stipend plus meals allowance. Diploma Apprentices will receive ₹13,200 stipend plus meals allowance.
